title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Amendment Charge and Amendment Ceiling
content:
Moving the collection or return time or branch of a rental is priced by the class booked. Two amounts stand on each of the six Car Rental Rate Classes.

| Rate class | Amendment charge (USD) | Amendments permitted |
|---|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 0.00 | 0 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 25.00 | 1 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 15.00 | 3 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 0.00 | 5 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 0.00 | 5 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 0.00 | 5 |

The amendment charge is the charge to move the collection or return time or branch. The ceiling is the maximum number of modifications permitted on one rental.

**The shape of the schedule.** The ceiling rises with the class and the charge falls to nothing: the Pay Now Saver Rate permits 0 amendments and publishes a charge of 0 beside that ceiling; the Pay Now Standard Rate permits 1 at 25; the Pay At Counter Flex Rate permits 3 at 15; and the Inclusive Flex Rate, the Premium Inclusive Rate and the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate each permit 5 at 0.
